commands.name: search-proteins
commands.summary: Search UniProtKB protein entries with a query; filters such as reviewed or organism go inside the query string

commands.name: count-protein-facets
commands.summary: Get facet counts (reviewed status, model organism, existence level, annotation score, length bins, etc.) for a UniProtKB query without fetching entries

commands.name: get-protein
commands.summary: Get the full UniProtKB entry (names, genes, organism, function comments, features, cross-references, sequence) for an accession

commands.name: download-protein
commands.summary: Download a UniProtKB entry as plain text: a FASTA sequence, the flat file, or GFF features

commands.name: get-protein-gene-centric
commands.summary: Get the gene-centric view of a protein: the canonical protein of its proteome plus related isoforms and fragments from the same gene

commands.name: get-protein-history
commands.summary: List all historical versions of a UniProtKB entry (UniSave) with release dates and sequence versions

commands.name: list-result-fields
commands.summary: List the valid result field names (for --fields) and the sortable fields of a UniProt database

commands.name: list-protein-search-fields
commands.summary: List the query field terms usable in UniProtKB queries (e.g. accession, gene, organism_id, reviewed), with examples

commands.name: search-taxonomy
commands.summary: Search taxonomy nodes by name, or list children/descendants with parent:<taxId> or ancestor:<taxId>

commands.name: get-taxonomy
commands.summary: Get a taxonomy node by NCBI taxon id: names, rank, parent, full lineage, links and protein/proteome counts

commands.name: search-keywords
commands.summary: Search UniProt controlled keywords (KW-xxxx) by name

commands.name: get-keyword
commands.summary: Get a UniProt keyword: definition, synonyms, parent hierarchy, category and protein counts

commands.name: search-diseases
commands.summary: Search UniProt human disease entries (DI-xxxxx) by name

commands.name: get-disease
commands.summary: Get a disease entry: definition, alternative names, cross-references (MIM, MedGen, etc.), keywords and protein counts

commands.name: search-uniref
commands.summary: Search UniRef sequence clusters (100%, 90% and 50% identity); filter identity in the query, e.g. 'hemoglobin AND identity:0.9'

commands.name: search-proteomes
commands.summary: Search proteomes by organism name; filter in the query, e.g. 'human AND proteome_type:1' for reference proteomes

commands.name: get-proteome
commands.summary: Get a proteome by UPID: description, taxonomy, type, and components (chromosomes) with protein counts

commands.name: get-alphafold-prediction
commands.summary: Get the AlphaFold predicted structure for a UniProt accession: confidence (pLDDT) and download URLs for PDB, CIF and PAE files
